areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Program builds social assistance units, a training school for the social assistance system and a shelter facility.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Qualifies services with integrated care for families, prioritizing the most vulnerable groups, including people experiencing homelessness.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Improves maternal and infant care through prenatal and birth good practices and adapts school facilities and teaching resources to age groups.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Qualifies municipal health management and governance across care levels and deploys digital health technologies such as telemedicine.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Creates a municipal reference center for older persons and structures an integrated social-services program for vulnerable citizens.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Develops and improves geolocation applications for the municipal health system.
